notes: Consumption History mein ab search hai — plan number ya date likh kar plan foran mil jata hai, aur Plan/Item toggle se tamam plans ke items ek hi list mein plan number aur date ke saath nazar ate hain. History se consumption Delete khatam kar diya gaya hai; correction sirf Edit se hogi. Mega tank par ab Shift ka button wazeh nazar ata hai — pehle wazan likhte hain, phir destination: plan ya doosra Mega tank, naam se chun kar. Mega screen par History button add hai: har Mega tank ki roz ki in/out movement, ingredients aur destinations ke saath.
releaseNotes: Consumption History search/nodelete + Mega shift/history pack: H1 search bar on desktop + mobile Consumption History filtering plans by plan number, sale order and date (raw ISO + rendered label). H2 Plan/Item toggle — Item mode flattens every plan's consumed items into one list with plan attribution (plan number + date per row; desktop gains a Plan Date column), search applies in both modes (shared src/utils/consumptionHistory.js). H3 consumption DELETE removed from History on both surfaces (no button, no handler, no util call); Edit stays incl. finalized-plan History edit; deletePlanConsumption util untouched for its other callers. H4 Mega Shift: visible labelled Shift button on every Mega tank plus a tank menu; flow is WEIGHT FIRST (kg <= held), then a destination popup offering plans AND Mega — Mega opens the Mega tanks BY NAME; new shiftMegaToMega util moves the exact kg with proportional composition + provenance segments to the source tank (a later basket on the target routes the portion home), both movement-log sides written. H5 Mega History: History button on the Mega screen; searchable tank list by name; per tank + selected date: Stock In total with ingredient-level breakdown incl. shift-ins with the source tank named, Stock Out total with destination detail (plan/phase/item or target Mega name), and the day's movement list. Append-only log in the Mega scope of app_config fgConsumptionTanks (meta.megaLog): {ts, tankId, tankName, kind: add|shift-out|shift-in, materials[], qty, destination/source}. The log starts with this release — no backfill of earlier movements. Verification: 526 node harness checks + 200 real-Chromium probe checks green; expectation changes (all caused by this pack): fg-mega-history harness W4/W9 and consumption-finalize harness W5/W6 rewritten for H4/H3, fg-mega-history probe H3 chain + H5 delete assertion rewritten, fg-shift-fix probe Mega segment rewritten weight-first, consumption-finalize probe U6 rewritten (record stays posted). Zero live-data writes.
